purpose: Machine-readable Phase 1 source registry. Collection creates reviewable signals; it does not publish events automatically.

sources.name: OurAirports
sources.notes: Canonical airport reference layer. Do not treat as live operational status.

sources.name: GDELT
sources.notes: Discovery only. Follow the original source before creating a TI event.

sources.name: GDACS
sources.notes: Disaster signal source. Endpoint availability/schema should be validated at runtime.

sources.name: NASA FIRMS
sources.notes: Requires FIRMS MAP_KEY. Keep key in GitHub Actions secrets; never commit it.

sources.name: ADSB.lol
sources.notes: Use as an aircraft signal, not as sole proof of airport/airspace status.

sources.name: ReliefWeb
sources.notes: Discovery/corroboration. Original report rights remain with the publisher.

sources.name: Safecast
sources.notes: Open global radiation observations. Use for anomaly detection and corroboration, not as proof of a radiological incident. Compare a station against its own baseline and nearby independent observations.

sources.name: US EPA RadNet
sources.notes: US near-real-time gamma monitoring. Use station-level trends/baselines; EPA notes normal levels vary by location and weather can affect readings.

sources.name: CTBTO radionuclide monitoring
sources.notes: 80-station radionuclide network. Use public CTBTO material for methodology/context; direct IMS data access requires the applicable CTBTO access route and conditions.

sources.name: IAEA IRMIS
sources.notes: Official emergency/radiation information source. Do not invent an API endpoint; investigate machine-readable access separately.

sources.name: CRUCIX Nuclear Watch
sources.notes: Secondary signal/corroboration layer. Do not scrape or publish CRUCIX readings directly without establishing access rights and provenance.
